Use this board for an in-class review. The instructor chooses a clue, decides whether the response is correct, and awards points to the class. Students work together and answer aloud; the game does not require accounts or student devices. The 42 clues are new practice questions aligned with the [midterm study guide](midterm-study-guide.qmd), not copies of the exam. Choose as many as fit the class period; you do not need to clear the board. Some higher-value clues may take several minutes.

Relational-algebra clues use the course notation, including $\pi$, $\sigma$, $\bowtie$, $\cap$, and $\cup$.

```{=html}
<div id="review-game" class="review-game">
  <div class="game-topline">
    <div>
      <p class="game-kicker">DATABASE DESIGN · REVIEW DAY</p>
      <h2>Jeopardy board</h2>
      <p class="game-status" id="game-status" aria-live="polite"></p>
    </div>
    <div class="game-top-controls">
      <div class="class-score-card">
        <span>Class total</span>
        <strong id="class-score" aria-live="polite">$0</strong>
      </div>
      <div class="game-actions">
        <button type="button" id="game-fullscreen" class="game-secondary">Full screen</button>
        <button type="button" id="game-reset" class="game-secondary">Reset game</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="game-board-scroll">
    <div id="game-board" class="game-board" aria-label="Jeopardy categories and clues"></div>
  </div>

  <div id="clue-overlay" class="clue-overlay" hidden>
    <section class="clue-dialog" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="clue-heading">
      <p id="daily-double-banner" class="daily-double-banner" hidden>Daily Double!</p>
      <div class="clue-header">
        <span id="clue-category"></span>
        <span id="clue-value"></span>
      </div>
      <h2 id="clue-heading" tabindex="-1">Clue</h2>
      <div id="clue-prompt" class="clue-prompt"></div>
      <div class="clue-scoring">
        <h3>Class score</h3>
        <p>Award this clue if the class solves it. You can undo an award before or after finishing the clue.</p>
        <div class="clue-score-actions">
          <button type="button" id="clue-award" class="game-primary" aria-pressed="false">Award points to class</button>
          <span id="clue-class-total" aria-live="polite">Class total: $0</span>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="clue-footer">
        <button type="button" id="clue-finish" class="game-primary">Finish clue</button>
        <button type="button" id="clue-close" class="game-secondary">Back without finishing</button>
      </div>
    </section>
  </div>
</div>
```

The board saves the class score and played clues in this browser. A played tile can be reopened to correct its scoring. **Back without finishing** leaves a new clue available; **Finish clue** marks it played. Use **Reset game** to start a new class session.

Clue topics draw on the [relations and keys activity](activities/week-02-relations-and-keys.qmd), [relational algebra assignment](assignments/assignment-02-relational-algebra-practice.qmd), [SQL joins lab](activities/week-03-query-reasoning-lab.qmd), [table-definition activity](activities/week-04-escape-room-schema.qmd), and [ER relationship activity](activities/week-07-er-relationship-practice.qmd).
